craft_notes: Sthāyin: the bhoga-sthāna rescue — recitation or no residual turn. Sanskrit-first: nātra śeṣavartanam kept negative (no remaining-turning); vā kept the alternative open; sā hi parāmarśasvabhāvā kept she-of-nature; prabuddhapaśucaitanye kept the paradox (awakened-paśu). Rows: 9 (here/there alternative pair), 1 ('in the consciousness of the already-awakened paśu' closes — the paradox named last), 2 (compound parāmarśasvabhāva held). Close: 'in the consciousness of the already-awakened paśu.' Rejected: resolving the paradox — killed: prabuddha-paśu IS the verse's tension; 'soul' for paśu — killed: paśu is the technical cattle-being (kept). Read aloud: IN the-en-JOY-ment-PLACE, FOR-yo-JA-na, AT-that-TIME in-HIS-jī-va-LA-ya — NO-re-main-ing-TURN-ing STANDS; OR BRAH-ma-vid-YĀ re-CIT-ed IN-the-EAR — OF-pa-rā-MAR-śa-NA-ture — IN-stant-ly a-WAK-ens VI-mAR-śa IN the-CON-scious-NESS OF the-al-READ-y-a-WAK-ened-PA-śu.

lines: In the enjoyment-place, for yojanā, at that time
in his jīvalaya — no remaining-turning stands;
or Brahma-vidyā recited in the ear —
in the consciousness of the already-awakened paśu.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhogasthāne yojanāya tatkāle ca tasya jīvalayaḥ nātra śeṣavartanam brahmavidyāṃ vā karṇe paṭhet sā hi parāmarśasvabhāvā sadyaḥ prabuddhapaśucaitanye prabuddhavimarśaṃ karoti

reads_against.argmap: What if yojanā falls in the enjoyment-place — what rescues it? → No residual turning remains there; the alternative is aural Brahma-vidyā, whose parāmarśa-nature instantly makes vimarśa manifest in the paśu's awakened consciousness.
c1_essence: No remaining-turning stands in the enjoyment-place; or Brahma-vidyā in the ear instantly awakens vimarśa in the awakened paśu's consciousness.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
